title: Clarifying a hand-in deadline
topic: A speaker corrects an earlier explanation and gives the latest acceptable hand-in time.
levelRationale: Understand a self-correction plus the sufficiency condition 出してくれればいい, keeping a deadline distinct from a start date. The polite confirmation responds to a familiar or senior speaker without converting relaxed urgency into a new obligation for today.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 最初のことばを聞いて、返事を一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen to the opening utterance and choose one response.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: あ、さっきの説明、間違えてた。今日中じゃなくて、来週の月曜日までに出してくれればいいよ。
turns.translation: Oh, I got my explanation wrong earlier. It doesn't have to be in by the end of today; handing it in by next Monday is fine.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 1。今日中に必ず出すんですね。分かりました。
turns.translation: One. I must hand it in by the end of today, then. Understood.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 2。月曜日から始めればいいんですね。分かりました。
turns.translation: Two. It's all right to start on Monday, then. Understood.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 3。月曜日まででいいんですね。分かりました。
turns.translation: Three. By Monday is fine, then. Understood.

options.label: 今日中に必ず出すんですね。分かりました。
options.translation: I must hand it in by the end of today, then. Understood.
options.rationale: This repeats the requirement that the speaker has just corrected.

options.label: 月曜日から始めればいいんですね。分かりました。
options.translation: It's all right to start on Monday, then. Understood.
options.rationale: Monday is the deadline for handing it in, not the day on which to start the work.

options.label: 月曜日まででいいんですね。分かりました。
options.translation: By Monday is fine, then. Understood.
options.rationale: This confirms the corrected latest acceptable hand-in time without adding a new condition.

explanation: 今日中じゃなくて explicitly repairs the earlier deadline. 月曜日までに is the time by which the hand-in must happen; it does not postpone the start of the work until Monday. 出してくれればいい says that handing it in by then is sufficient. 間違えてた is the familiar spoken form of 間違えていた.

vocabulary.gloss: had got it wrong; casual form of 間違えていた
